recordingBinding.recordingEdition: 1974 original Second Helping studio album performance
recordingBinding.notes: The frozen Genius song-detail response for candidate1268 identifies Sweet Home Alabama by Lynyrd Skynyrd, album Second Helping, released1974-04-15 and recorded at Studio One, Doraville. The band's official history confirms the song is on Second Helping; its official discography gives the album release date. McGill's Billboard index independently identifies the same title/artist in the 1974 Hot100 chart sample (entry0107, chart date1974-10-26, actual rank8). This binds the charting studio performance to the album edition at performance level; it does not claim byte-identical master or pressing identity.
